title: Exoplanet atlas
brief: A spectacular interactive exploration of the real confirmed-exoplanet catalogue (6,316 planets from the NASA Exoplanet Archive, embedded): an animated discoveries-per-year timeline by detection method, a radius-vs-orbital-period log-log scatter colored by equilibrium temperature with the temperate-rocky band highlighted, a nearest-worlds table, a detection-method breakdown with per-method reach, and a weirdest-worlds spotlight — hover tooltips everywhere.
da: Deep-field planetarium: black-violet nebula and live starfield, glassy translucent panels, plasma cyan/magenta accents, Space Grotesk display over IBM Plex Mono readouts.
